test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

BEAM : YVZN :: WORD : DLIW :: PLAN : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0f78ec4c361ec893d966e99e716fbdb57e16f42284c4d9e2db6ef216d2faec6.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**Logic:** The letters are coded with their opposite letters according to the positional value table.

BEAM : YVZN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d505abf855e69aacacb41ab7a99654c728c4ea034aa3dccc67245ad02f2355f7.png] 

WORD : DLIW →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ba07366ad46db11f6f9411e69527a1735869779cde0165d5ce394af531614a3.png] 

Similarly, for 'PLAN :?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6030de5c98c3046ae22c619fb899f4f5355dd73ad90a642b2fe7019f1e8ff197.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "KOZM".
